import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_82/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_82/training_1.csv"

df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history: JOIN : [["Source2_82_1", "Source2_82_0"], ["movieId", "movieId"]]
# Join df_source1 and df_source0 on "movieId"
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source1, df_source0, on="movieId", how="inner")

# Transform columns to match target schema and types:
# Target Schema: ['userId': int, 'movieId': int, 'rating': float, 'timestamp': int,
#                 'title': string, 'genres': string, 'genres_arr': string, 'genre_count': string]

# Ensure correct dtypes
df_joined['userId'] = df_joined['userId'].astype(int)
df_joined['movieId'] = df_joined['movieId'].astype(int)
df_joined['rating'] = df_joined['rating'].astype(float)
df_joined['timestamp'] = df_joined['timestamp'].astype(int)
df_joined['title'] = df_joined['title'].astype(str)
df_joined['genres'] = df_joined['genres'].astype(str)

# Create 'genres_arr' column: list of genres as string representation of Python list
df_joined['genres_arr'] = df_joined['genres'].apply(lambda x: str(x.split('|')))

# Create 'genre_count' column: the first genre in the genres list (as per target examples)
df_joined['genre_count'] = df_joined['genres'].apply(lambda x: x.split('|')[0] if x else '')

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df_target = df_joined[['userId', 'movieId', 'rating', 'timestamp', 'title', 'genres', 'genres_arr', 'genre_count']]

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_82/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_82/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_82/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on movieId
result = pd.merge(source1, source0, on="movieId", how="inner")

# Process genres to genres_arr (list of genres as string) and genre_count (first genre)
result["genres_arr"] = result["genres"].str.split("|").apply(lambda x: str(x))
result["genre_count"] = result["genres"].str.split("|").str[0]

# Write output with exact target schema column order
result = result[["userId", "movieId", "rating", "timestamp", "title", "genres", "genres_arr", "genre_count"]]
